# `pattern`

## `pattern.findall`

`pattern.findall(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> list[str] | list[tuple[str, ...]]`

*filter*

Return every non-overlapping match: strings, or tuples of groups.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.findall('Hi, you two') | join('|') }}`` → ``Hi|you|two``
- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.findall('Hi, you two', 3, 7) | join('|') }}`` → ``you``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date | pattern.findall('2026-11 1999-01') | map('join', '/') | join }}`` → ``2026/111999/01``

## `pattern.finditer`

`pattern.finditer(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> Iterator[Match[str]]`

*filter*

Return an iterator of match objects.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.finditer('ab cde') | map('match.span') | map('join', '-') | join('|') }}`` → ``0-2|3-6``

## `pattern.flags`

`pattern.flags(value: Pattern[str], /) -> int`

*attribute*

The flags the pattern was compiled with, plus the engine's defaults.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ (word | pattern.flags) // re.I % 2 }}`` → ``1``

## `pattern.fullmatch`

`pattern.fullmatch(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> Match[str] | None`

*filter, test*

Return the match if the pattern matches all of `string[pos:endpos]`, or None. Also a test.

- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.fullmatch('2026-11') }}`` → ``True``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.fullmatch('2026-11!') }}`` → ``False``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.fullmatch('2026-11!', 0, 7) }}`` → ``True``

## `pattern.groupindex`

`pattern.groupindex(value: Pattern[str], /) -> Mapping[str, int]`

*attribute*

Map each named group to its number.

- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ (date | pattern.groupindex)['month'] }}`` → ``2``

## `pattern.groups`

`pattern.groups(value: Pattern[str], /) -> int`

*attribute*

The number of capturing groups.

- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date | pattern.groups }}`` → ``2``

## `pattern.match`

`pattern.match(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> Match[str] | None`

*filter, test*

Return the match at the start of `string[pos:endpos]`, or None. Also a test.

- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date | pattern.match('2026-11!') | match.group('month') }}`` → ``11``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.match('on 2026-11') }}`` → ``False``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.match('on 2026-11', 3) }}`` → ``True``

## `pattern.pattern`

`pattern.pattern(value: Pattern[str], /) -> str`

*attribute*

The pattern string.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.pattern }}`` → ``\w+``

## `pattern.search`

`pattern.search(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> Match[str] | None`

*filter, test*

Return the first match in `string[pos:endpos]`, or None. Also a test.

- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date | pattern.search('on 2026-11') | match.group('year') }}`` → ``2026``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date is pattern.search('on 2026-11') }}`` → ``True``
- ``{% set date = re.compile('(?P<year>\\d+)-(?P<month>\\d+)') %}{{ date | pattern.search('2026-11', 1) | match.group }}`` → ``026-11``

## `pattern.split`

`pattern.split(value: Pattern[str], /, string: str, maxsplit: int = 0) -> list[str | None]`

*filter*

Split `string` by the matches. Groups in the pattern are kept.

- ``{{ re.compile(',\\s*') | pattern.split('a, b,c') | join('|') }}`` → ``a|b|c``
- ``{{ re.compile(',\\s*') | pattern.split('a, b,c', 1) | join('|') }}`` → ``a|b,c``

## `pattern.sub`

`pattern.sub(value: Pattern[str], /, repl: str | Callable[[Match[str]], object], string: str, count: int = 0) -> str`

*filter*

Replace matches in `string` with `repl`: a string (`\1`, `\g<name>`) or a macro.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.sub('#', 'ab, cd') }}`` → ``#, #``
- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.sub('[\\g<0>]', 'ab, cd', 1) }}`` → ``[ab], cd``
- ``{% macro up(m) %}{{ m | match.group(0) | upper }}{% endmacro %}{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.sub(up, 'ab, cd') }}`` → ``AB, CD``

## `pattern.subn`

`pattern.subn(value: Pattern[str], /, repl: str | Callable[[Match[str]], object], string: str, count: int = 0) -> tuple[str, int]`

*filter*

Like `pattern.sub`, but return `(new_string, number_of_substitutions)`.

- ``{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.subn('#', 'ab, cd') | join('|') }}`` → ``#, #|2``
- ``{% macro up(m) %}{{ m | match.group(0) | upper }}{% endmacro %}{% set word = re.compile('\\w+', re.I) %}{{ word | pattern.subn(up, 'ab, cd', 1) | join('|') }}`` → ``AB, cd|1``
